summary: Recent updates to Firefox's image decoders focus on improving performance and efficiency when handling images on the web. One notable change is the caching of the specification hash on the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI), which helps speed up the processing of images by avoiding redundant calculations. This enhancement means that Firefox can now retrieve images faster and more reliably, leading to a smoother browsing experience overall. While users may not see _immediate visual changes_, **this optimization significantly contributes to quicker image loading times**, making web pages more responsive.
